release_notes: Release v1.1.29: Added multi-category bookmarks (تلاوة, حفظ, مراجعة, تدبر, مهم) with custom categories, colors, and full CRUD; integrated dynamic playback speed controls (0.5x - 2.0x) in Quran player and range player; enabled background audio playback with lock screen media notification controls; and designed custom Medina Mushaf book logo and launcher app icons.
